_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md)

pit_profile.why: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($26.79B in FY08); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Accenture's own FY2008 10-K names off-shore providers, 'particularly Indian providers ... often at highly competitive prices', among its competitors and warns that 'the continuation of pricing pressures could result in permanent changes in pricing policies', while its own Global Delivery Network grew to about 83,000 people. The stock trades at 9.8x FY09E — a discount to its own history. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (OFFSHORE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing offshore substitution for ACN specifically.

classification.quality_note: Accenture: global consulting and outsourcing leader across five operating groups with record bookings ($26.79B in FY08); discretionary consulting demand is cyclical, the franchise is not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.21x; -25% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +2.25; conservative 2yr +117%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.3%/yr (latest guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.3-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.3%/yr (FY03-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +28.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: ACN (retrospective, 2008-12-05) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.21x (-38.0% downside to Bear $39 / +183.0% upside to Bull $80) | Adj composite 3.25 vs market 1.00: gap +2.25 [UNDERVALUED] | -25% above the EPP floor $38 (13x FY09E $2.89) | Conservative 2-yr case: +117.4% total (+58.7%/yr) | At 9.8x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $37 sits at or below the BASE case; consulting +11% LC in Q4, FY09 guided +9-12% LC; offshore competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
